sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN python.share > sql.share THEN 'Python' ELSE 'SQL' END AS more_in_demand
FROM (
  SELECT
    share
  FROM mart_skill_demand
  WHERE
    skill = 'python'
) AS python
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    share
  FROM mart_skill_demand
  WHERE
    skill = 'sql'
) AS sql;
